items.title: Google Search
items.subtitle: Tap the magnifier in the Search tab and pick Google to find Reddit threads. Results open right in Apollo.

items.title: Comment Links in Share as Image
items.subtitle: When you share a comment as an image, attach the comment's own link, the post's, or none.

items.title: Menus Where You Press
items.subtitle: In the fullscreen viewer, Copy, Save and Share open right where you press and hold.

items.title: Clearer Comment Errors
items.subtitle: When a comment can't post, Apollo says why: a removed post, a locked thread, or a ban.

items.title: Toon Bot Icons
items.subtitle: Toon Bot and Happy Toon Bot join the Concepts icon pack.
